title: Amazon Listing Optimization: Titles, Bullets and Images

facts.fact: Amazon recommends product titles under 60 characters, though the actual character limit is higher.
facts.quote: Amazon recommends titles under 60 characters, but the character limit is higher.

facts.fact: Amazon allows up to 9 product images per listing, or 8 images and a video.
facts.quote: Amazon allows up to 9 images (or 8 and a video). Use them all.

facts.fact: Amazon product images should be between 500px and 10,000px on the longest side.
facts.quote: Between 500px and 10,000px on the longest side

facts.fact: The main Amazon product image should use a pure white background of RGB 255, 255, 255.
The product should fill at least 85% of the image on an Amazon listing.
facts.quote: Product fills at least 85% of the image

facts.fact: The page's Amazon product image checklist contains seven points to check before uploading each image.
facts.quote: Check every image against these seven points before you upload it.

facts.fact: Best Seller Rank is a popularity score within a product category where a lower number is better and #1 is the top seller.
facts.quote: A lower number is better, with #1 being the top seller.

facts.fact: The guide is organized around six pillars of optimized product listings.
